title: Darth Vader NOOOO
blurb: Cinema's most operatic refusal, from the galaxy's most dramatic man. Vader's NOOOOOOO closes Revenge of the Sith and was later spliced into Return of the Jedi for the 2011 Blu-ray release, and somewhere around then the internet decided it belonged to everyone. The meme value lies entirely in scale — the wifi drops, the fries are cold, they killed off the only good character. Channelling the full theatrical devastation of a Sith lord into a minor inconvenience never gets old. The Dark Side understands, and the Dark Side overreacts.
origin: Darth Vader's anguished cry from Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith / Return of the Jedi.
